text:
leo_sales: AcmeX wants a concise latency/throughput run for their execs. Goals: sustain 250 qps, tolerate 3x microbursts (20s) up to 750 qps, p95 <200ms. Need a one-pager + cost delta (hosted vs dedicated).
meera_se: Do we have token sizes and model variant? that'll determine batching.
tom_perf: They provided averages: prompt ~70 tokens, response ~140 tokens -> ~210 total. Model: community 70B quant (8-bit). Mix: 80% short chat, 20% long completions.
meera_se: Proposed test plan: A) warmup 5m @30% load; B) steady 30m @250 qps; C) burst matrix: 3 bursts at 400/600/750 qps 20s each, 90s apart; D) cross-AZ 10% fallback for 10m. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, batch sizes, GPU util.
aya_ops: Infra sketches: with KV cache and batching, sustained 250 qps ~5 GPUs (A100 equiv); keep 8 GPUs for burst headroom. Hosted runs same but expect ~1.7x unit cost. Autoscale cooldown 60s to avoid oscillation.
tom_perf: Prewarm: prime KV with ~2k representative prefixes + run a 10m low-rate fill to warm kernels. For Dedicated recommend 10% warm standby.
irene_sec: Security asks: SSO metadata, KMS for keys, DPA signed if using customer PII. For demo corpus Hosted ok; for prod data require Private or strict EP clause.
leo_sales: Can we give a ballpark monthly cost for 1M reqs/mo (avg 210 tokens/req)?
aya_ops: Quick ballpark: Hosted inference ~ $4k/mo (depends on token charge & burst), Dedicated reserved ~ $2.6k/mo amortized + ops. We'll create a clear comparison after runs.
tom_perf: Loadgen snippet we'll use:
```
wrk -t12 -c380 -R750 --script=chat_mix.lua --latency $TARGET
```
Also run steady via -R250 for 30m.
ci-bot: perf job #1204 queued: container build OK.
meera_se: We'll measure with KV on/off and quant=8 vs quant=16 to show latency/cost tradeoffs. Include sampling traces 0.5% for root-cause.
leo_sales: Timeline: customer wants deck by Tue. Can we do internal dry-run tomorrow morning and customer-facing run Friday?
tom_perf: I can run dry-run tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need corpus + API key with same model variant.
aya_ops: I'll provision test cluster: 8 x A10g equiv, us-west2, logs to secure bucket; creds to vault.
irene_sec: I'll assemble the checklist and required contract language for KMS/DPA.
meera_se: Action items: 1) leo upload sample corpus (EOD today). 2) aya provision infra (tomorrow 07:30). 3) tom run dry-run and post quick metrics. 4) irene share sec checklist.
leo_sales: Uploading corpus now: https://redwood-internal/pocts/acmex/corpus. Booking tentative Friday slot.
ci-bot: perf job #1204 completed: results uploaded to secure storage.
tom_perf: Dry-run quick results: steady 250 qps p95=178ms, p99=395ms. Burst 750 qps p95 peaked ~560ms, p99 ~1.05s. KV-cache off -> p95 up ~30%. Raw CSV and charts in secure link.
meera_se: Good signals. We'll draft the one-pager with runbook, graphs, recommended runtime knobs (batch_wait_ms=1024, max_batch_tokens=32k, kv_cache=true, quant=8) and cost appendix.
leo_sales: Perfect. I'll sync with AcmeX and confirm DPA status before the customer run. :thumbsup:
